links.outcome: Consistency of LLM triage and advice across equivalent messages varying in emotional tone
links.effect: Urgent, threatening and demanding framings raised same-day/urgent care from 14% to 37%-63% (V up to 0.69, P<0.001); emotional tone raised empathy responses from 62% to 70%-86%; similar shifts in real messages.
links.quote: Urgent, threatening, and demanding framings increased same-day or urgent care from 14% to 37%-63% (V up to 0.69, P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating how patient communication style/tone biases agentic LLM triage and decision outputs using vignettes and retrospective messages, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
